summary: casecheck's self-test lines of a case's tooling memory, each fault in a private copy of cases.c or of the case schema found by its own line

argv: ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -O1 -I tools/etude -I tools/etude/include -I utils tools/etude/casecheck.c ${SRC}/tools/etude/cases.c tools/etude/digest.c tools/etude/judge.c tools/etude/json.c tools/etude/processor.c tools/etude/qemu_profile.c tools/etude/schema.c tools/etude/verdict.c tools/etude/history.c tools/etude/history_json.c utils/sha256.c -o ${WORK}/casecheck && mkdir -p ${WORK}/schemas && cp tools/etude/schemas/*.json ${WORK}/schemas/ && cp ${SRC}/tools/etude/schemas/case.schema.json ${WORK}/schemas/case.schema.json

d=$TMPDIR/selftest && mkdir -p $d/fixtures && cp tools/etude/fixtures/memory.json tools/etude/fixtures/tooling.json $d/fixtures/ && grep -F -e '| tooling-' -e '| !tooling-' -e ' ./tooling.json' tools/etude/fixtures/expect > $d/fixtures/expect && ln -s ${WORK}/schemas $d/schemas && ${WORK}/casecheck --selftest $d/fixtures; s=$?; rm -rf $d; exit $s

faults.name: short
faults.summary: a machine case whose tooling memory does not cover its machines is not reported

lines: | tooling-short: tooling_memory_bytes does not reserve QEMU memory and overhead

faults.name: exact
faults.summary: a machine case whose tooling memory is exactly what its machines take is reported

faults.name: guest
faults.summary: the schema takes a guest case's tooling memory

lines: | /cases/0/resources: has "tooling_memory_bytes", which this form does not allow
